name: simulate_restriction_digest
description: Simulate restriction enzyme digest of a DNA sequence using BioPython, returning cut sites and fragment sizes
usage: from app.tools.biomni.molecular_biology import simulate_restriction_digest; result = simulate_restriction_digest('GAATTCATGCATGCGGATCCAAA', enzymes=['EcoRI', 'BamHI'])

parameters.enzymes: list — restriction enzyme names e.g. ['EcoRI', 'BamHI', 'HindIII'] (default: common cloning enzymes)

returns: dict with keys: sequence_length, cut_sites (dict per enzyme), n_fragments, fragments (list of {start, end, size})
